title: Claude Cowork vs Metal: tasks or a bot team?
h1: claude cowork vs Metal: files, schedules and bot teams
description: Cowork is becoming part of Claude. Compare its file tasks and cloud schedules with Metal, including the limits of local routines.
answer: **choose between handing claude a task and keeping a team of named bots.** cowork is becoming part of claude as of 12 november 2026.[^1] dusk gives each bot its own job, memory and ai choice. both schedule work. new cowork tasks on pro, max and ultra run in the cloud, so laptop sleep is no longer the deciding difference.[^2]
og_line: claude tasks or separate bot teammates.

them: **you want file work in claude’s own app.** hand over an outcome without using a terminal.
**you want its remote schedules.** they come with a paid claude plan.
dusk: **you want lasting, separate roles.** give the reviewer and planner different jobs and memory.
**you want to change the ai without starting over.** each bot keeps chats, files and memory.

compare.intro: **both can schedule work; the daily arrangement differs.** details are as of 12 november 2026. the claude column includes its move to cloud tasks.

method:
**compare the work you will repeat, then try it with your own files.** we publish Metal. we did not run identical tasks in both apps.

anthropic's sources were checked on 12 november 2026. newer cloud-task help supersedes older desktop sleep advice. the table names the affected plans so you can match them to yours.

sections.h: start with the work, not the chat box
sections.md:
**hand over a document task, or keep a teammate for the next one too.** cowork brings claude code's agent architecture to work beyond coding, with no terminal required.[^3]

claude code cloud schedules package a prompt, repositories and connectors. schedules, api calls or github events can start them.[^12] that suits work beginning in a code repository.

for documents you want back for review, cowork is a direct fit. dusk keeps lasting roles. [ai teammates](/ai-teammates) shows a reader and planner with different jobs and memory.

sections.h: find out which answer leaves you less work
sections.md:
**see which one catches the promise that changed.** give both tools two versions of a proposal you can share. ask for changed promises and unanswered questions. leave both files untouched.

compare each answer with the originals. did it find the new deadline? how much still needs your attention? a polished summary is cheap if you have to do the review again.

in dusk, attach the files and use **ask for approval** for commands and file changes. keep connected apps read only; those limits block app changes separately.[^7][^13]

sections.h: price the setup you will actually use
sections.md:
**both can keep working with your laptop shut.** new cowork tasks on pro, max and ultra moved to the cloud on 6 october 2026. the local-only option went away.[^2]

current schedules run remotely too. older tasks created before that date can remain local.[^5] the [schedule guide](/guides/claude-scheduled-tasks) separates them.

dusk desktop routines still need an awake machine and open app. dusk cloud changes their home; ai usage stays on your provider's bill.[^8][^9][^11] include a work license when needed. use the [pricing guide](/guides/claude-cowork-pricing) before deciding from one headline price.

faq.q: can i switch new cowork tasks back to my computer?
faq.a: **new tasks stay in the cloud.** since 6 october 2026, pro, max and ultra cowork tasks run there. anthropic removed the local-only option. that remains true as of 12 november 2026.[^2]

faq.q: does cowork stop when my laptop is closed?
faq.a: **new cloud tasks keep going with the lid shut.** that covers pro, max and ultra work and remote schedules. older local tasks can still need an awake computer.[^2][^5]

faq.q: can i run claude and another ai as separate teammates?
faq.a: **yes, dusk gives each bot its own ai.** put them in a group chat to share work. read each provider's current sign-in terms.[^6][^10]
